But of course black can still go to C8 and now it seems like black is simply out of the woods. It still [music] has the only queen on the board and once the queen comes out white will be lost. A beautiful concept leaving the position as it is and taking a step back with the king. But as it turns out black is in zugzwang, a situation where the only [music] way to not lose would be to not make a move. If we look at the moves available to the queen we can see that now all of these squares are covered by the king. This is covered by the pawn, these are all covered by the pawn and if the queen goes to the corner now there is still going to be a fork with the pawn attacking the king and queen and winning the queen.
